help.title: Help
help.lead: Answers to common questions, and a way to reach the team.

free.a: Yes. Joining the community, the events listed as free and the guides are free.

signin.a: Enter your email on the sign-in page and we send you a link. No password needed.

profile.a: You decide field by field in Settings, Profile. Your email is never shown publicly.
